title: The Nine say they are behind nuclear-base sightings

tellings.quote: Uh they kind of say like we're kind of behind a lot of the sightings that that are occurring at nuclear bases.

plain: In the 1970s a group calling itself "The Nine", said to be a council of non-human intelligences speaking through human contacts, claimed it was behind many of the UFO sightings at nuclear weapons bases. An unnamed researcher on the show says this, drawing on tapes of contact sessions run by the scientist Andrija Puharich, whom the episode describes as having worked with the CIA. According to the researcher, The Nine say "we're kind of behind a lot of the sightings" at nuclear bases, which would give a claimed author for those incidents.
